summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K with an Appendix 3G notification regarding the issuance of 546,279 performance rights under an employee incentive scheme, issued on April 28, 2026. These unquoted equity securities were granted to non-KMP personnel. No price, premium, or consideration is disclosed as this is a routine equity grant. The filing is a standard corporate housekeeping matter with no change in control, restructuring, or capital return event. The registrant is acting solely as issuer. There is no special situation warranting an event-driven classification.
